summary: Admin Dashboard feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 26/26 pytest passed (admin/stats auth guards + payload, products CRUD+search+soft-delete, admin write=403 for buyer/401 no token, customers CRUD incl. status/password update + duplicate username 409 + short password 400 + soft-delete, profil_admin PUT validation for empty WA/nama_toko + persistence, /api/upload admin-only + /api/files/{path} public read of uploaded PNG, seed data profil_admin whatsapp=6285312812452 & admin/buyer users). Frontend (390x844): admin login -> home shows 'Buka Dashboard Admin'; /dashboard stats visible; /dashboard/produk FAB opens product-form; created product 'TEST_UI_*' appears in list, product-search filters it, delete via ConfirmDialog confirm-ok removes it. /dashboard/pelanggan FAB opens customer-form; created customer appears; customer-status-toggle + save works. /dashboard/profil clearing whatsapp+save shows red alert 'Nomor WA wajib diisi' (profil-error); valid save shows profil-success. Buyer buyer/buyer123 has no open-dashboard-button and visiting /dashboard redirects to /home. No red screens, no expo/react-native deprecated packages found.

issues: stat card testID uses Indonesian label 'Menunggu Approval' rather than 'Pending' as implied by the review request. This is cosmetic only — value renders correctly (3 pending).

critical_code_review_comments: product-form and customer-form call router.back() after save; when opened via a deep link (no back stack) this triggers a 'GO_BACK was not handled' warning. In-app FAB navigation works fine, but consider router.replace('/dashboard/produk') / router.replace('/dashboard/pelanggan') as a safer fallback.
server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') hooks — cosmetic only.
PUT /api/admin/customers/{id} allows setting/changing username without a length check on the new value (unlike POST which enforces >=3). Minor validation gap.
/api/upload accepts any content-type; consider restricting to image/* explicitly (currently only extension is trusted for storage path).
seed_data_creation: No manual seed needed — backend startup seeds profil_admin (whatsapp 6285312812452), admin/admin123, buyer/buyer123. UI test created and deleted a product (soft-deleted) and left one 'tcust*' buyer + one status-toggled customer in DB from previous manual runs (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_admin_dashboard.py + test_diana_auth.py for regression. Frontend M3TextField wraps a real <input>/<textarea>; select via '[data-testid="<containerTestID>"] input' (e.g. product-nama, customer-username). Opening product-form/customer-form via deep link is not recommended — go via /dashboard/produk (or /pelanggan) FAB so router.back() works after save. profil-error text starts with an icon glyph (\U000f05d6) followed by 'Nomor WA wajib diisi'.
